tools.name: add_brand
tools.title: Check my brand in AI answers
tools.description: Start measuring a brand: does ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude or Google AI mention it, and who does AI recommend instead? Give the brand's website (or its app store, Google Maps, YouTube or Instagram link). It reads the site, picks the buyer questions, and starts the first scan across the AI engines. Reading the site takes 1-2 minutes; if it is still running, call again with the same link and it picks up the same run, never a second one. Returns the brand_id; then use get_scan_status.

description.description: Optional: what the brand sells, in a sentence. Only needed when add_brand says it couldn't read the website.

link.description: The brand's website, like acme.com, or its app store, Google Maps, YouTube or Instagram link.

locations.description: Optional: the cities or areas where the brand's buyers are, like ["Pune", "Indiranagar, Bengaluru"]. Its buyer questions are then split across them and its numbers shown per location. Leave out for a brand with one location.

tools.name: create_prompt
tools.title: Track a new buyer question
tools.description: Adds a buyer question to a topic so it is asked on every engine in the plan from the next run. Counts toward the plan's question limit. Calling again with the same text returns the existing question, never a duplicate.

confirm_new_engines.description: Set true to confirm using an engine this workspace has never used before.

target_engines.description: Optional: limit to these engines. Omit for the plan's engines.

text.description: The question, phrased the way a buyer would ask an AI assistant.

tools.name: get_changes
tools.title: What changed in my AI visibility?
tools.description: What moved over the window: the daily mention-rate trend, how much the engines' answers changed, notable changes on competitors' websites, and new pages about the category.

brand_id.description: Brand id from list_brands. May be omitted when the workspace tracks a single brand.

window_days.description: Trailing window in whole UTC days ending today. Default 30.

tools.name: get_citations
tools.title: Which sources do AI answers cite?
tools.description: The websites AI answers cite for the brand's buyer questions, ranked by share of citations and by how many answers cite them, and where the brand's own site ranks.

brand_id.description: Brand id from list_brands. May be omitted when the workspace tracks a single brand.

engines.description: Optional: only these engines (e.g. openai, perplexity, anthropic, google_aio). Default: the engines the dashboard headline counts (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Google AI Overviews, plus any the plan adds); the reply's counted_engines names them.

window_days.description: Trailing window in whole UTC days ending today. Default 30.

tools.name: get_competitors
tools.title: Who does AI recommend instead of me?
tools.description: The competitors AI answers name for the brand's buyer questions, per engine, with each one's share of voice against the brand and how it changed over the window.

brand_id.description: Brand id from list_brands. May be omitted when the workspace tracks a single brand.

engines.description: Optional: only these engines (e.g. openai, perplexity, anthropic, google_aio). Default: the engines the dashboard headline counts (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Google AI Overviews, plus any the plan adds); the reply's counted_engines names them.

window_days.description: Trailing window in whole UTC days ending today. Default 30.

tools.name: get_fix_verification
tools.title: Did my fix work?
tools.description: Each fix marked shipped for the brand with its mention rate before and after and a verdict: moved (beyond normal answer churn), within_noise, or awaiting_samples. Fixes marked "Not a fix" are left out; auto-detected page changes carry source auto_detected.

brand_id.description: Brand id from list_brands. May be omitted when the workspace tracks a single brand.

limit.description: Most recent fixes to return. Default 20.

tools.name: get_loop
tools.title: What happened from question to verified fix?
tools.description: The brand's loop, oldest first: each buyer question tracked, gap found, content draft created, fix published to the brand's site, fix shipped, change seen on the brand's own pages, and fix checked after it ships: a first check on day 28, re-checks on days 45, 60 and 75 and a final check on day 90 (whether it is still live and how citations, mentions and AI-referral traffic moved, each with its sample size; a horizon appears only once it has been measured). The first page also lists before_window: each question's newest draft, publish and shipped fix from before since, its current state. At most 90 days per call (the last N days is since = today minus N-1, today counted); page with next_cursor.

brand_id.description: Brand id from list_brands. May be omitted when the workspace tracks a single brand.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous call, to continue.

since.description: Window start: RFC 3339 timestamp or YYYY-MM-DD. Default 90 days before until.

stages.description: Optional: only these stages. Default every stage.

until.description: Window end: RFC 3339 timestamp or YYYY-MM-DD (that whole day). Default now. At most 90 days after since.

tools.name: get_report_link
tools.title: Get a shareable AI visibility report
tools.description: A link to the brand's AI visibility report to share with a team or client: how often AI answers mention the brand, which competitors they name instead, and which sources they cite. Returns the newest finished report's own unlisted link. Reports are built automatically after a brand's first scan.

brand_id.description: Brand id from list_brands or add_brand. May be omitted when the workspace tracks a single brand.

tools.name: get_scan_status
tools.title: Is my brand's scan done?
tools.description: Progress of a brand's first scan after add_brand: the stage, how many AI answers are in out of how many expected, per engine, and when it should finish. Once complete, use get_visibility for the results.

brand_id.description: Brand id from list_brands or add_brand. May be omitted when the workspace tracks a single brand.

tools.name: get_visibility
tools.title: Is my brand mentioned in AI answers?
tools.description: How often ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude and Google AI mention the brand when buyers ask about its category. by=engine (default): mention rate, share of voice, average position, citation share and sentiment per engine, with the change from the previous period. by=question: each buyer question's mention rate and rank. A brand measured in several locations also gets locations: each location's mention rate, change and the competitor AI names most there, weakest first.

brand_id.description: Brand id from list_brands. May be omitted when the workspace tracks a single brand.

engines.description: Optional: only these engines (e.g. openai, perplexity, anthropic, google_aio). Default: the engines the dashboard headline counts (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Google AI Overviews, plus any the plan adds); the reply's counted_engines names them.

window_days.description: Trailing window in whole UTC days ending today. Default 30.

tools.name: list_brands
tools.title: List my tracked brands
tools.description: The brands this workspace tracks in AI answers, with ids and websites. Call first; every other tool takes a brand_id.

tools.name: list_fix_opportunities
tools.title: What should I fix to show up in AI answers?
tools.description: The gaps that keep AI engines from citing or recommending the brand, each with its evidence and the suggested fix. Gives the gap_id mark_fix_shipped needs.

brand_id.description: Brand id from list_brands. May be omitted when the workspace tracks a single brand.

include_closed.description: Also return gaps that were checked and no longer apply. Default false.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.title: Which buyer questions are tracked?
tools.description: The topics and buyer questions this workspace asks ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude and Google AI for a brand. Gives the topic_id create_prompt needs.

brand_id.description: Brand id from list_brands. May be omitted when the workspace tracks a single brand.

tools.name: mark_fix_shipped
tools.title: I shipped a fix
tools.description: Records that a fix shipped, against a gap_id from list_fix_opportunities or a published content_draft_id, so get_fix_verification can measure whether it moved the brand's mention rate. Calling again with the same fix and description returns the existing record.

acknowledge_unfilled_gaps.description: A content draft that still has [INSERT ...] gaps is refused and the gaps listed. Set true only after the user confirms the shipped page has them filled.

brand_id.description: Brand id from list_brands. May be omitted when the workspace tracks a single brand.

content_draft_id.description: A published content draft (one of gap_id or content_draft_id).

description.description: What shipped, in one or two sentences.

gap_id.description: The gap finding the fix addresses (one of gap_id or content_draft_id).

shipped_at.description: When it shipped: RFC 3339 timestamp or YYYY-MM-DD. Default now.

tools.name: see_example
tools.title: See an example AI visibility card
tools.description: Shows what Proofsource measures, without signing in: a real visibility card for one example brand (Tesla), from answers collected from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude and Google AI Overviews. It shows how often AI answers mention the brand, per engine, which competitors they name instead, and sample answers. Use it when someone asks whether their brand shows up in AI answers and has not signed in. It always shows the example brand; to check their own brand they sign in.

brand.description: Optional: the brand the person asked about. The example card is shown either way, with a note to sign in to check that brand.

resources.description: An AI visibility card: how often AI answers mention the brand, per engine, the competitors named instead, and sample answers. The card shows the numbers, so do not repeat them in full.
resources.name: visibility
resources.title: AI visibility card
